## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Windows manual testing completed (when applicable)

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No notification, clipboard or calendar content is sent off-device.
- [ ] No new permissions or privileged IPC paths were added without documentation.
- [ ] Logs contain no private payloads or credentials.

## Screenshots / logs

Attach only sanitized materials. Remove private notification text, clipboard contents, calendar feed URLs and tokens.
